about: Endep (amitriptyline) 25 mg at night is supplied every month for nine months and appears by brand name only.
Dothep 75 (dosulepin) 75 mg at night is supplied four times from December 2025 to March 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Zoloft (sertraline, an antidepressant that is not on the list) is supplied every month. No tricyclic antidepressant is supplied.
